settings.title: Details & fit
settings.content:
Heavyweight 260gsm cotton, garment-dyed and vintage-washed.

Oversized, dropped shoulder, boxy length. Model is 180cm wearing L.

Screen-printed back, embroidered eye mark on the chest.

settings.title: Shipping & returns
settings.content:
Ships in 5 to 7 business days, made to order. Free UAE delivery over AED 299; other destinations are calculated at checkout.

Returns within 14 days on unworn Essential and Memory tiers. Signature commissions are final sale.

settings.title: How the NFC works
settings.content:
After checkout you upload your memory: photo, voice, or video. It links to the chip behind the chest logo.

Tap any phone to the chest logo to play it. No app needed. You can change the memory anytime.

settings.title: A real pair of eyes
settings.text: The back print is a photograph, not an illustration: torn, layered, and screen-printed at true grain so the eyes stay recognizably someone's.

settings.title: Tap to remember
settings.text: A hidden NFC chip behind the chest logo links to whatever you choose to keep there: a voice memo, a photo, a date. Tap a phone to the chest logo and it plays.

settings.title: Heavyweight, vintage-washed
settings.text: 260gsm heavyweight cotton, garment-dyed and washed for a worn-in hand from the first day. Oversized fit: take your usual size, or size down for a closer fit.
